tooltips.Total AI Cost Spend: What every LLM call through the AI gateway cost in the selected period.
tooltips.Total AI Cost: What every LLM call through the AI gateway cost in the selected period.
tooltips.Avg. Cost per Request: Average cost of a single LLM call.
tooltips.Total LLM Requests: LLM calls made through the AI gateway.
tooltips.Spend by Model: Share of the spend that went to each model.
tooltips.Model Affinity: Share of LLM calls that went to each model.
tooltips.Cost per Agent: Spend per agent. Each agent's LLM proxy name starts with its LLM configuration name.
tooltips.Avg Cost per LLM Call: Average cost of one call per day.
tooltips.Daily Token Usage: Prompt and completion tokens sent through the gateway per day.
